name: nested-border-radius
description: When writing or reviewing CSS for nested rounded-corner elements (cards inside cards, buttons inside panels, modals with inner content areas, etc.), ALWAYS use this skill. It provides the correct nested border-radius formula to ensure visually harmonious inner radii that don't look awkward or misaligned. Use whenever the user mentions border-radius, rounded corners, nested cards, padding inside rounded containers, or any UI element that sits inside another rounded element. This applies to Tailwind, CSS modules, inline styles, design systems, and component libraries.
